title: Privacy Policy
intro: This policy explains what data MagicMail collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. We've tried to write it in plain language, because we think privacy policies should be readable.

sections.heading: 1. What we collect
paragraphs: When you create an account, we collect your name, email address, and (if you choose to sign in with Google) your Google account identifier. That's the minimum we need to operate the service.

When you connect your inbox, we access the emails in that inbox so the agent can read, sort, and draft replies. We also collect basic technical information — browser type, operating system, and IP address — to keep the service secure and diagnose issues.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your data
list: Provide the service — reading, sorting, and drafting replies to your emails
Keep your account secure and prevent abuse
Send you service emails, like password resets and billing receipts
Diagnose bugs and improve the product

sections.heading: 3. What we never do
paragraphs: We never sell your data. We never rent it. We never share it with advertising networks or data brokers.
We never train AI models on your emails. Your content stays between you and the agent — it isn't used to improve anyone else's experience.

sections.heading: 4. How your emails are handled
paragraphs: When you connect your inbox, emails are processed through an encrypted pipeline. The agent reads each email, decides how to route it, and stores only what's needed for the service to function — for example, the summary, category, and any drafts you've asked it to create.
Raw email content is never stored longer than necessary. Once the agent has processed an email, the original stays in your inbox (where it always was) and our copy is discarded.

sections.heading: 5. Sharing with third parties
paragraphs: A small number of trusted providers help us run the service. These include our cloud hosting provider, our payment processor, and our email delivery provider. Each of them sees only what's needed to do their job, and each is bound by a contract that restricts how they can use your data.
We don't share your data with anyone else unless we're legally required to.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You can access, export, or delete your data at any time. To do any of these, email privacy@magicmail.app and we'll process your request within 30 days.

If you're in the EU, UK, or California, you have additional rights under GDPR and CCPA — including the right to object to processing, the right to correct inaccurate data, and the right to file a complaint with your local data protection authority. We honor all of these.

sections.heading: 7. Data retention
paragraphs: We keep your account data for as long as your account is active. If you delete your account, we delete your data within 30 days — except where we're legally required to keep specific records (for example, billing records, which we retain for tax purposes).

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Access to production systems is limited to a small number of engineers and is protected by two-factor authentication.
If you believe your account has been compromised, email security@magicmail.app immediately.

sections.heading: 9. Children
paragraphs: MagicMail isn't intended for anyone under 16. We don't knowingly collect data from children, and if we learn that we have, we'll delete it.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we'll change the 'last updated' date at the top of this page and notify you by email if the changes are significant.
